shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && ls -R .agents | head -50 && cat AGENTS.md && ls -la && git show --stat HEAD | head -40
cat package.json src/*.tsx index.html tsconfig.json; head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui
rg -n -C 6 -i "page-constructor" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | sed -n '1,80p'; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -150
npm view @gravity-ui/page-constructor version peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -30
npm install @gravity-ui/page-constructor@8.24.1 @diplodoc/transform 2>&1 | tail -15; git diff --stat package.json
.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh page-constructor PageConstructor PageConstructorProvider HeaderBlock ExtendedFeatures BannerBlock 2>&1 | head -60
bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh page-constructor PageConstructor PageConstructorProvider HeaderBlock ExtendedFeatures BannerBlock 2>&1 | head -60
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor && cat build/docs/INDEX.md | head -120; ls build/docs build/docs/* | head -80

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs && sed -n '120,400p' INDEX.md | rg -n -i -C4 "vite|sass|scss|theme|locale|lang" | head -80; cat blocks/Header.md blocks/ExtendedFeatures.md blocks/Banner.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor && rg -n -i -C3 "vite|dynamic-import|animated|theme\b|PageConstructorProvider" build/docs/INDEX.md README.md | sed -n '1,120p'; rg -n "animated|theme|isAnimationEnabled" build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/Provider.d.ts build/esm/context/animateContext/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; ls build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/

cat build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/Provider.d.ts; sed -n '1,60p' build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/PageConstructor.d.ts; rg -n "import\(" build/esm -g '*.js' | head -5; ls styles; rg -n "animated" build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/Provider.js

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models && rg -n "interface PageContent|interface PageData|animated|ExtendedFeaturesBlockProps|HeaderBlockProps |BannerBlockProps|enum BlockType" -r '$0' . | head -30; rg -n -A12 "export interface PageContent" .

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && cat vite.config.ts .gitignore; rg -n "Theme\b.*=|enum Theme" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/models/common.d.ts | head; npm install -D sass vite-plugin-dynamic-import 2>&1 | tail -3

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm && sed -n '1,12p' models/common.d.ts; cat context/localeContext/*.d.ts | head -20; rg -n "Theme|BlockType" index.d.ts models/index.d.ts | head; rg -n "color|style" blocks/Banner/Banner.js sub-blocks/BannerCard/BannerCard.js 2>/dev/null | head
rg -n "^export" index.d.ts | head -20; rg -n "ExtendedFeatures|HeaderBlock|Banner" models/constructor-items/common.d.ts models/constructor-items/blocks.d.ts | rg -n "enum|= \"" | head
sed -n '1,8p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/utils/url.js; rg -n "url\.|parse\(|format\(" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/utils/url.js | head
git status --short && git diff package.json
rm -rf dist
